contract: Play MP4, Matroska and TS video through Player, CaptionBridge and TextBridge; compare with the pinned FFmpeg subtitles build's A/53 frame side data passed to the CEA-608 decoder. Compare DVB teletext through TeletextTsBridge and TextBridge against libzvbi teletext in ASS mode.

Fold the ASS headers, complete ASS cue bytes, presentation and duration clocks in microseconds and distinct page clears. Teletext uses the same page and layout options; the plain-text receiver mode is covered by the standalone teletext comparison.

Preload the container on both sides. Opening and reading the container, caption extraction or page decoding, folding and teardown are inside the operation. The reference's video decode is needed to observe A/53 side data.
